svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a blank 100 wide x 170 long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the bottom 23 mm back 90 degrees to make a foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 5.5 mm holes in the foot, 14 mm behind the face, at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 and 78 mm from the left edge, for 5 mm deck screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 4 mm clip holes 115 mm above the deck, at 20 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 78 mm from the left edge (the separator and drier centres).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a third 4 mm clip hole 78 mm above the deck, 49 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the left edge, for the deoxidizer clip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands 5 mm behind the separator; the foot points back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The separator and drier clips screw to it; the deoxidizer

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stands on the foot and is clipped to it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: upright square to the deck; the clips line up with
